exec(open('helpers.py').read())
y=labels_all()
X=np.vstack([np.load('pass_7/cls_hidden_L12.npy'),np.load('pass_8/cls_hidden_L12.npy')]).astype(np.float64)
Wf,b=ridge_fit(X,y,0.2)
L=X@Wf+b
print('train acc', (L.argmax(1)==y).mean(), 'logit range', L.min(), L.max())
Wp=np.zeros((768,768),np.float32); bp=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
Wp[:8,:]=(0.1*Wf.T).astype(np.float32); bp[:8]=(0.1*b).astype(np.float32)
Wc=np.zeros((8,768),np.float32); Wc[np.arange(8),np.arange(8)]=10.0
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight',Wp); save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias',bp)
save_edit('classifier.weight',Wc); save_edit('classifier.bias',np.zeros(8,np.float32))
pooled=np.tanh(X@Wp.T.astype(np.float64)+bp)
lg=pooled@Wc.T
print('sim acc', (lg.argmax(1)==y).mean(), 'agree', (lg.argmax(1)==L.argmax(1)).mean())
np.save('readout_v3_Wf.npy',Wf); np.save('readout_v3_b.npy',b); np.save('sim_logits_v3.npy',lg)
with open('notes.md','a') as f:
    f.write("\n## v3 readout (saved): ridge lam .2 on pass_7+pass_8 c12 (1496). pooler rows0-7=0.1*Wf^T, bias 0.1*b; classifier 10*I. train acc printed in run 35. Files readout_v3_*.npy, sim_logits_v3.npy\n- Next: pass9 predict edited on 512 ids to verify pipeline vs sim_logits.\n")
